environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; iconic fan-shaped leaves with soft, undulating edges; high-quality leaf textures with subtle veins; golden-yellow accents mixed with forest greens.

visual_logic.composition: A serene shot of a Ginkgo branch reaching out over a stagnant marsh. Some leaves are beginning to turn a pale gold, contrasting with the dark olive water.
visual_logic.ground: Dark forest floor littered with fallen fan-shaped leaves and dark, decaying organic matter.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, low-angle sunlight hitting the leaves from the side, highlighting their unique shape and texture.
